items.event_time_ist: Issued 5:00 AM PDT, Oct 13 (5:30 PM IST, Oct 13)
items.title: NHC: advisories likely initiated later today on EP93 as a tropical depression or tropical storm
items.summary: NHC 5:00 AM PDT Tropical Weather Outlook (Pacific): EP93 — a broad low several hundred miles south of southern Mexico — now shows better-organized showers/thunderstorms and satellite-derived wind data indicating the circulation is becoming better defined. Formation chance remains high, near 100% (48h and 7d). NHC says if current trends continue, advisories will likely be initiated later today on a tropical depression or tropical storm; the system moves WNW ~10 mph and southwestern Mexico interests should keep monitoring. Still unnamed — the next eastern Pacific name is Trudy.
items.source_name: NWS National Hurricane Center (Tropical Weather Outlook, 5 AM PDT Oct 13)
